description: Atomic claim of one card for the host that owns its agent; the reconnect variant returns the same attempt.
notes: Reconnect sends { execution_attempt_id, lease_token } and receives the same pair back instead of a new attempt.
todo, failed, done, canceled and in_review are refused with 422 INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION; an active lease held by another attempt answers 409 LEASE_HELD_BY_OTHER.
